### Added
- **Downstream progress reaches the caller.** A tool call whose `_meta` carries a `progressToken` (on `call_tool` or a tool called directly) now gets the `notifications/progress` of the downstream tools it reaches, under its own token; before, muster sent no token downstream and relayed no progress, so a long-running tool showed nothing until its result. muster sends each downstream request a token of its own and routes the notifications by it, so a connection shared by several sessions hands each caller only its own progress; a notification for a token no call in flight carries, or one whose progress does not increase, is dropped and counted in `muster_downstream_progress_notifications_total`. ([#974](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/974))
